g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-301 Ribbon blender 6 cu ft (built in house) · rev B
Non-contact: #4 or bead blast; welds cleaned; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: lower cross rail at the drive end only (free end open)
square; holes Ø20.5 x 2 top+bottom at x ±300
drill on assembly to the NORD arm
through the top rail, welded top and bottom
on the drive-end legs, outer face
1. Tack the two side frames (legs + top and lower rails) flat on the table, check diagonals equal within 2 [.08], then stand them up and add the bearing plates and the lower cross
2. Bearing plates: weld square to the rails and to each other: the two Ø80 holes on one axis within 0.5 [.02] (check with a string line or the Ø63.8 bar). Bearings are shimmed and
shifted in the Ø17.5 holes (slots allowed to 17.5 x 22) at assembly.
3. Top of rails and bearing plates coplanar within 1 [.04] (lug seats rest here). Feet level within 1 on the table before grouting/anchoring.
4. All tube joints: fillet 3 [.12] all round, ends sealed (no open tube ends: caps on legs, rails closed by the legs). Clean, passivate.
